elements.content: A dog happened to get a piece of meat. He carried it in its mouth on the way home. He was going to eat quietly at home. On his way back, he had to cross a wooden bridge over a rushing stream. While crossing the river, he looked down and saw his reflection in the water below. He thought it was another dog holding another piece of meat, so he decided to get that piece of meat too. He made a snap at the shadow in the water. But when he opened his mouth, the meat fell into the water.

child_list.content: 狗和影子
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content: 一只狗碰巧得到一块肉。在回家的路上，他把它叼在嘴里。他准备安安静静地回家吃。在回去的路上，他必须穿过湍急小溪上的一座木桥。过河时，他往下看，看到了自己在水中的倒影。他以为是另一只狗叼着另一块肉，所以他决定把那块肉也拿走。他朝水中的影子猛咬了一下。但当他张开嘴时，肉掉进了水里。

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
